description: TSS Maps for Power BI brings live Esri ArcGIS mapping into your Power BI reports, with full two-way interaction between the map and the rest of your report page. Select features on the map and your report filters with them; slice anywhere else and the map follows. Points, lines and polygons render from your Power BI dataset alongside your own ArcGIS feature services, so operational GIS data and business data share one canvas. Key capabilities -Native spatial layers from your Power BI data — points, lines and polygons in GeoJSON or WKT, not just latitude and longitude -Two-way cross-filtering between map features and every other visual on the page -Multiple map layers from a single dataset, with per-layer symbology, draw order and scale ranges -Reference layers from ArcGIS Online, ArcGIS Enterprise and WMS, including secured layers via Microsoft Entra ID sign-in -2D maps and 3D scenes, with elevation, daylight, weather and Gaussian splat layers -Data-driven colour: qualitative, quantitative and custom class breaks with an in-canvas break editor -Measurement, sketch selection, time-aware layers with a time slider, and an in-canvas editor for formatting without leaving the report -Geocoding from address or place-name columns, plus latitude and longitude -Basemap gallery covering imagery, streets, topographic, terrain and canvas styles Who it is for Teams in energy, utilities,…
